statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Unknown"'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // ""'); used_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); in_tok=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.current_usage.input_tokens // .context_window.total_input_tokens // 0'); out_tok=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.current_usage.output_tokens // .context_window.total_output_tokens // 0'); branch=""; [ -n "$cwd" ] && branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); worktree_branch=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.worktree.branch // empty'); [ -n "$worktree_branch" ] && branch="$worktree_branch"; out=$(printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m' "$model"); [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[2m|\033[0m') $(printf '\033[33m⎇ %s\033[0m' "$branch")"; if [ -n "$used_pct" ]; then used_int=$(printf '%.0f' "$used_pct"); if [ "$used_int" -ge 80 ]; then col='\033[31m'; elif [ "$used_int" -ge 50 ]; then col='\033[33m'; else col='\033[32m'; fi; out="$out $(printf '\033[2m|\033[0m') $(printf "${col}ctx: %s%%\033[0m" "$used_int")"; fi; [ "$in_tok" != "0" ] || [ "$out_tok" != "0" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[2m|\033[0m') $(printf '\033[35min:%s out:%s\033[0m' "$in_tok" "$out_tok")"; printf '%b\n' "$out"
